class Solution:
    def subsets(self, nums: List[int]) -> List[List[int]]:
        res = []

        subset = []

        def dfs(i):
            if i >= len(nums):
                res.append(subset.copy())
                return
            # decision to include nums[i]
            subset.append(nums[i])
            dfs(i + 1)
            # decision NOT to include nums[i]
            subset.pop()
            dfs(i + 1)

        dfs(0)
        return res

description: 给定无重复整数数组，返回所有子集，包括空集。
explanation: 按位置决定选或不选，或回溯时把当前路径加入答案，并仅向后选择。共 2ⁿ 个子集。
memory: 子集不关心排列，选择下标必须单向推进。
